workloads.label: Data Ingestion & ETL
workloads.source: Based on Data Ingestion Pipelines: Kafka/CDC guidance
workloads.justification: Airflow-orchestrated batch ingestion from Oracle Exadata and Azure SQL DW sources into Snowflake raw layer. 7-day gaming operations require daily loads including weekends. M warehouse sized for 100 GB-1 TB daily volumes from legacy platform migration.
workloads.notes: Oracle Loki decommission driving initial heavy load phase. Fast ramp reflects experienced SciPlay team executing lift-and-shift.

workloads.label: ELT Transformation (Medallion)
workloads.source: Based on RAW / HARMONIZED / ANALYTICS / PUBLISH architecture
workloads.justification: Three-layer Medallion transformation pipeline covering raw landing, harmonised dimensional models, and analytics aggregations. Airflow-orchestrated dbt-style transformation running 6 hours daily on a 7-day schedule across multiple game platform instances (OGS, GDM, GCM).
workloads.notes: Dynamic Tables used for aggregation layer - billed as warehouse compute. Oracle Loki materialised views require migration-phase transformation effort.

workloads.label: BI Analytics - Power BI DirectQuery
workloads.source: Based on currentbitool: MSFT Power BI
workloads.justification: Power BI DirectQuery against Snowflake for 24/7 iGaming operations analytics. MCW required for 25+ concurrent users across trading, customer services, risk, and marketing teams. L warehouse needed for large game event table queries. 16 active hours covers peak + extended operations window. Multi-cluster (min 1, max 3) handles concurrency spikes during peak gaming periods.
workloads.notes: 7-day operation confirmed - gaming operations run continuously. Fanatics NJ launch will increase US operations analytics concurrency.

workloads.label: Operational Apps - Streamlit & iGaming Tracker
workloads.source: Based on Streamlit Apps, iGaming Tracker, Operational Analytics
workloads.justification: Streamlit-based operational dashboards for game operations, player monitoring, and the iGaming Tracker application. 12-hour active window covering business and extended operations hours. Separate from BI analytics warehouse to isolate application load.
workloads.notes: Customer Sentiment, Location Recommendation, Customer Loyalty, and Operational Analytics listed as use cases in future state architecture. CACI and Weather Source marketplace data integration adds enrichment workload.

workloads.label: Fraud & Risk Analytics
workloads.source: Based on Player fraud detection, ML ops
workloads.justification: Continuous fraud detection and risk scoring queries running against live game event streams. Slow ramp reflects ML model development and validation cycle. M warehouse provides sufficient capacity for near-real-time batch scoring. 16-hour window covers peak active gaming periods where fraud exposure is highest.
workloads.notes: Current fraud risk exposure identified at over 3 million dollars annually - primary business justification for Snowflake adoption. Warehouse works alongside Snowpark ML feature engineering pipeline.

workloads.label: Regulatory Reporting
workloads.source: Based on Regulatory reporting: 10 projects/year each 3 months to deliver
workloads.justification: Dedicated warehouse for regulatory reporting across iGaming jurisdictions. S warehouse sized for complex aggregate queries over historical transaction data. 22 weekday days reflects compliance team working pattern. Significant cost savings versus current 500K annual spend on manual reporting.
workloads.notes: 10 regulatory report projects per year currently costing 50K each. Snowflake reduces delivery time enabling faster regulatory response.

workloads.label: Data Science & SnowPark ML
workloads.source: Based on ML ops, feature engineering
workloads.justification: SnowPark-based feature engineering and ML model training for fraud detection models and data-driven content recommendations. Slow ramp reflects model development lifecycle. M warehouse selected for feature pipeline compute intensity. Current workload runs in AWS SageMaker - gradual migration to Snowpark.
workloads.notes: AWS SageMaker currently used for data science - incremental migration to Snowpark. ML inference workloads may increase this estimate significantly once models are productionised.

workloads.label: Development & Testing
workloads.source: Standard development warehouse - industry best practice for new Snowflake deployments
workloads.justification: Dedicated development and testing warehouse for SciPlay-seconded engineers and Snowflake PS team building the migration. XS warehouse sufficient for development queries. Available from day 1 to support onboarding and initial build.
workloads.notes: SciPlay team of experienced Snowflake engineers seconded for first 6 months. Snowflake PS delivery manager and 2 senior solution architects also require dev access.

snowpipe.source: Kafka streaming via Snowpipe Streaming API replaces file-based Snowpipe
snowpipe.justification: Kafka confirmed as streaming source. Snowpipe Streaming (row-level insert API) is preferred over file-based Snowpipe for event-driven iGaming workloads.

snowpipe_streaming.source: Based on Client Tooling: Power BI, Kafka
snowpipe_streaming.justification: Kafka streaming pipeline ingesting game event data (bets, spins, player actions) continuously into Snowflake. 500 GB/month uncompressed is a conservative estimate for mid-market iGaming operator with UK and Malta operations.

assumptions: AWS EU Frankfurt selected as primary deployment region based on Salesforce opportunity data confirming primarydeploymentregion: Europe - Frankfurt.
Enterprise edition selected based on RBAC, SSO/MFA, VPN, and audit logging requirements confirmed in Snowflake enablement agenda.
20% annual growth rate applied from Year 2 onwards, consistent with iGaming industry growth trends and the Fanatics New Jersey market expansion initiative.
Power BI DirectQuery assumed for iGaming operations analytics requiring real-time data access; import mode would reduce warehouse compute significantly.
L warehouse with MCW (min=1, max=3) sized for estimated 25+ concurrent Power BI users across trading, risk, customer services, and marketing teams.
16 active hours per day assumed for BI warehouse covering peak gaming operations window; 24/7 operation would increase BI credits by approximately 50%.
30 days per month applied to all gaming operations workloads (ingestion, BI, fraud, Streamlit) to reflect continuous 7-day iGaming operations.
Kafka game event streaming ingested via Snowpipe Streaming at estimated 500 GB/month uncompressed; actual volume depends on event rate and message size.
Medallion architecture (RAW, HARMONIZED, ANALYTICS, PUBLISH) confirmed from future state architecture in PoV plan; 6 transformation hours per day includes all three layers.
15 TB raw data estimated for initial migration from Oracle Exadata and Azure SQL DW sources including 3 years of historical game event data; actual volume to be confirmed during data discovery.
4x compression ratio applied for structured relational data; game event JSON logs may compress at 5-10x improving this estimate.
3-day Time Travel retention set for regulatory compliance requirements; standard default is 1 day.
20% monthly data churn rate applied reflecting insert-heavy gaming transaction pattern.
Fraud & Risk Analytics sized at M warehouse running 16 hours daily; actual compute requirements depend on ML model inference complexity and batch scoring frequency.
SnowPark ML warehouse is incremental migration from AWS SageMaker; full ML workload migration may increase this estimate.
DR replication targeted to AWS EU Ireland (nearest AWS region to Frankfurt); initial 4 TB seed estimated from compressed data estate.
0.5 TB/month replication change rate estimated for gaming transaction volume; actual value to be validated using SYSTEM$ESTIMATE_REPLICATION_COST.
Snowflake Marketplace subscriptions estimated at 500 USD/month for CACI, Weather Source, and FX Rates data products; actual pricing varies by listing.
Oracle Loki decommission assumed complete within first 12 months; no ongoing Oracle CDC required post-migration.
SciPlay seconded engineering team (experienced Snowflake users of 5-6 years) enables a faster ramp curve for ingestion and transformation workloads.
Regulatory reporting warehouse sized at S for aggregate compliance queries; complex cross-jurisdictional reports may require M warehouse.
Development and testing warehouse available from Day 1 to support SciPlay team and Snowflake PS onboarding activities.
Serverless Tasks enabled for lightweight scheduled maintenance alongside Airflow as primary orchestrator.
Clustered Tables enabled for game event history tables with date-range and player-ID query patterns.
Data Quality Monitoring enabled for financial and player activity tables to support regulatory audit requirements.
confirm_required: Concurrent Power BI user count: confirm 25+ concurrent users justify L warehouse with MCW (min=1 max=3). Difference between S/1 cluster and L/MCW is approximately 340,000 credits per year (+/-130% of BI line item).

7-day vs weekday-only operation for BI and fraud workloads: confirm gaming operations run 7 days per week. Weekday-only (22 days) would reduce BI and fraud credits by approximately 27% (-74,000 credits/yr).

Kafka game event volume: confirm uncompressed GB/month through Snowpipe Streaming. Current assumption 500 GB/month; 10x increase to 5 TB/month adds only 185 credits/year (negligible vs warehouse cost).
Oracle Loki migration scope and timeline: confirm total data volume (current assumption 15 TB raw). Each additional 5 TB adds approximately 1.25 TB compressed storage (about 370 USD/year).
Fraud analytics frequency: confirm whether fraud scoring is batch (current assumption: 16h/day M warehouse) or near-real-time stream processing. Real-time would require dedicated streaming warehouse.
SnowPark ML migration from AWS SageMaker: confirm which ML models will migrate to Snowpark in Year 1 vs remain in SageMaker. Full migration could add 2-4x current ML warehouse estimate.

DR replication initial data volume: run SYSTEM$ESTIMATE_REPLICATION_COST to validate 0.5 TB/month change rate assumption. Difference between 0.5 and 2 TB/month changes replication cost by approximately 7,200 USD/year.
PrivateLink requirements: confirm whether network security policy requires PrivateLink for Snowflake connectivity. Each endpoint adds approximately 88 USD/month.
Snowflake Marketplace data product pricing: confirm actual contract pricing for CACI, Weather Source, and FX Rates listings. Estimate of 500 USD/month to be validated.
Cortex Complete use cases: confirm specific fraud analytics use cases for LLM completions. If not adopted in Year 1, removes 1,596 AI USD per year.
Power BI import vs DirectQuery mode: if Power BI uses Import mode with scheduled refresh, the BI warehouse reduces from L/MCW to M/single-cluster and saves approximately 320,000 credits per year.

Live Data Sharing with operator customers: PoV plan shows LIVE DATA SHARING with no data movement. Confirm if reader/managed accounts are required for iGaming operator partners - each account adds warehouse compute costs.
